#!/bin/sh
set -eu
sh bin/labels.sh tests/data/shelf-a.csv build/shelf-a.txt
printf 'QA76.73 S5
Shell Basics

PR6045 O72
The Waves and Other
Short Pieces

HD9696 B3
Grids

' > build/shelf-a.want
cmp -s build/shelf-a.txt build/shelf-a.want || { echo "shelf-a labels differ"; exit 1; }

input.command:
v=docs/plans/label-wrap/verification-records; o=$v/objects; mkdir -p "$o"
record() { r=$v/T-02/$1; shift; mkdir -p "$r"
  files=$(ls bin/*.sh tests/*.sh tests/data/*.csv)
  for f in $files; do h=$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | cut -d" " -f1); cp "$f" "$o/$h"; printf '"%s": "%s",\n' "$f" "$h"; done > "$r/inputs-before.txt"
  printf '{"argv": "%s", "cwd": "%s", "start": "%s", "timeout_seconds": 60, "timeout": "not enforced"}\n' "$*" "$(pwd)" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$r/start.json"
  "$@" > "$r/stdout.bin" 2> "$r/stderr.bin"; code=$?
  for f in $files; do printf '"%s": "%s",\n' "$f" "$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | cut -d" " -f1)"; done > "$r/inputs-after.txt"
  printf '{"argv": "%s", "child_exit": %s, "end": "%s"}\n' "$*" "$code" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$r/result.json"
  printf '# Check record — T-02 %s\n' "$1" > "$r/receipt.md"; }
record run-1 sh tests/run.sh
record run-2 sh bin/labels.sh tests/data/shelf-a.csv build/shelf-a.txt
a=$(shasum -a 256 build/shelf-a.txt | cut -d" " -f1); cp build/shelf-a.txt "$o/$a"; printf '{"build/shelf-a.txt": "%s"}\n' "$a" > $v/T-02/run-2/artifacts.json

content.text: T-02 is Complete; records in verification-records/T-02/run-1 and run-2; artifacts.json parses.
